mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id,u.username,a.version,u.permission_version,u.session_version, (u.is_enabled AND u.is_account_non_expired AND u.is_account_non_locked AND u.is_credentials_non_expired) AS enabled, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_revoked_session r WHERE r.session_id=#{sessionId} AND r.user_id=u.user_id AND r.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS revoked FROM sys_user u CROSS JOIN authz_state a WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND a.state_id=1
mapper.update: UPDATE authz_state SET version=version+1 WHERE state_id=1
UPDATE sys_user SET permission_version=permission_version+1 WHERE user_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_revoked_session(session_id,user_id,expires_at) VALUES(#{sid},#{id},#{expiry}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expires_at=VALUES(expires_at)
mapper.select: SELECT version FROM authz_state WHERE state_id=1 FOR UPDATE
